info.name: Terrasight P0 contract
info.description: Contract tests for P0 endpoints (Tech Design §14, §16). Generated by tools/postman/build-collection.mjs.

item.name: Sign in before the first workspace
Mutating request without X-Requested-With is refused (CSRF)
Signing up again with the same email answers the same (no account enumeration)

exec: pm.test("same body as a new address", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ status: "ok" }));

item.name: One user = one company: a second company is refused
Another workspace is not found (not forbidden)
Owner adds an agronomist; the Agronomist role is limited (S-01.03, S-01.04, PD v2.10, v2.12)
Create the agronomist: a one-time setup link
The retired roles admin and viewer are refused
An email that already has an account is refused (one user = one company)

exec: pm.test("clear message", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("This email is already used by another account"));

item.name: The agronomist sets a password from the link

exec: pm.test("signed in as the agronomist", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.workspaces).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(b.workspaces[0].role).to.eql("agronomist"); });

item.name: An agronomist cannot create another company
Agronomist can open the event stream topic list (read)

exec: const m = pm.response.json().members; pm.test("owner + agronomist", () => pm.expect(m.map((x) => x.role).sort()).to.eql(["agronomist", "owner"]));

item.name: The last Owner cannot step down
Remove the member (the account is deleted)
The removed user can no longer sign in
The removed email can be used for a new user again
Create an agronomist: a one-time setup link

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test("link shown once, no password", () => { pm.expect(b.setupUrl).to.match(/^\/setup\//); pm.expect(b.expiresAt).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: The same email is already used
Members list shows who has not set a password
Login without a password fails generically
A new link replaces the old one
The old link no longer works
Set the password: signs the user in

exec: pm.test("signed in as the new user", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().email).to.eql(pm.variables.replaceIn("ira-{{run}}@example.com")));

item.name: A 10 m square is too small
Preview a field near Garden City, KS

exec: pm.test("quick land check: null (could not be checked) or a status with plain reasons", () => { pm.expect(p).to.have.property("suitability"); if (p.suitability) { pm.expect(["suitable", "limited", "unsuitable", "unknown"]).to.include(p.suitability.status); pm.expect(p.suitability.reasons).to.be.an("array"); } });

item.name: Add the field (gather starts in the same transaction)

exec: const f = pm.response.json(); pm.test("gather job", () => pm.expect(f.gatherJobId).to.be.a("string")); pm.collectionVariables.set("fieldId", f.id);

item.name: Gather status lists one task per source
History and the field carry the land suitability (null until the history is built)

exec: const h = pm.response.json(); pm.test("suitability key", () => { pm.expect(h).to.have.property("suitability"); if (h.suitability) { pm.expect(["suitable", "limited", "unsuitable", "unknown"]).to.include(h.suitability.status); pm.expect(h.suitability.reasons).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(h.suitability.blocked).to.be.a("boolean"); } });

item.name: An agronomist marks the land as cropland (override stores who and when)

exec: const f = pm.response.json(); pm.test("override stored", () => { pm.expect(f.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("fieldId")); if (f.suitability) { pm.expect(f.suitability.override.userId).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(f.suitability.override.at).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(f.suitability.blocked).to.eql(false); } });
const f = pm.response.json(); pm.test("override cleared", () => { if (f.suitability) pm.expect(f.suitability.override).to.eql(null); });

item.name: Unknown crop cannot be set for a past season
Season record names the source of each value

exec: const r = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("season", r.season); pm.test("sources", () => ["crop", "sowingDate", "emergenceDate", "tillage"].forEach((k) => pm.expect(r[k]).to.have.property("source")));

item.name: Suggested sowing window, emergence and tillage for a chosen crop

exec: const r = pm.response.json(); pm.test("shape", () => { pm.expect(r.crop).to.eql("corn"); pm.expect(r.sowing).to.have.property("status"); pm.expect(["open", "not-yet", "late", "closed", "unknown"]).to.include(r.sowing.status); pm.expect(r).to.have.property("emergence"); pm.expect(r).to.have.property("tillage"); }); pm.test("unverified values are flagged", () => { if (r.emergence) pm.expect(r.emergence.verified).to.be.a("boolean"); if (r.tillage) pm.expect(r.tillage.verified).to.be.a("boolean"); });

item.name: Suggestion rejects a crop outside the library
Agronomist confirms crop and sowing date

exec: const r = pm.response.json(); pm.test("confirmed", () => { pm.expect(r.crop).to.eql({ value: "winter_wheat", source: "confirmed" }); pm.expect(r.sowingDate.source).to.eql("confirmed"); });

item.name: Analyze fields starts a manual run (S-03.02)

exec: pm.test("manual run with the field", () => { pm.expect(r.trigger).to.eql("manual"); pm.expect(r.fields.map((f) => f.fieldId)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("fieldId")); });

item.name: Retry one field as a new run
Start a chat with the assistant (S-05.02)

exec: const c = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("convId", c.id); pm.test("expires in 90 days", () => pm.expect(new Date(c.expiresAt) - new Date(c.createdAt)).to.be.within(89.9 * 864e5, 90.1 * 864e5));

item.name: Ask a product question: answered by the refusal template
Read the chat: aliases map and messages

exec: const c = pm.response.json(); pm.test("aliases", () => pm.expect(Object.keys(c.aliases)[0]).to.match(/^F\d+$/)); pm.test("user message stored", () => pm.expect(c.messages[0].role).to.eql("user"));

item.name: Start a chat from the field panel (tied to the field)

exec: const c = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("fieldConvId", c.id); pm.test("tied to the field", () => pm.expect(c.contextFieldId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("fieldId")));

item.name: Latest chat of the field: the panel restores it after navigation

exec: const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.test("one row, the field chat", () => { pm.expect(rows).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(rows[0].id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("fieldConvId")); });

item.name: Plan for 2026 is empty at first (S-06.06)
Unknown crop can't be saved to the plan
Crop prices: the company's own list starts empty, in the workspace currency

exec: pm.test("shape", () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(["USD", "UAH"]).to.include(r.currency); pm.expect(r.rows).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(r.crops).to.be.an("array"); });

item.name: Crop prices: a zero price is invalid
Crop prices: an unknown crop is invalid
Crop prices: save corn with an expected yield

exec: pm.test("saved", () => { const r = pm.response.json().rows.find((x) => x.crop === "corn"); pm.expect(r.pricePerT).to.eql(180); pm.expect(r.yieldRefTHa).to.eql(8.5); });

item.name: Scenario run with an out-of-range slider is invalid
A check needs an existing recommendation (S-07.01)
A recommendation view carries its data basis (S-10.12)

exec: pm.test("dataBasis is an array when the item exists", () => { if (pm.response.code === 404) return; pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().dataBasis).to.be.an("array"); });

item.name: Unknown scouting task is not found
A photo link without a valid signature is refused

exec: pm.test("shape", () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.items).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(r.recipients).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(r.counts).to.have.keys("waiting", "question", "decided"); pm.expect(["en", "uk"]).to.include(r.language); });

item.name: An unknown decision state is refused
Ask the owner needs an existing recommendation
An answer must be approve, not_now or question
Unknown decision has no reply draft

exec: pm.test("shape", () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.unread).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(r.items).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(r.items.length).to.be.at.most(30); });

const l = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("linkToken", l.token); pm.collectionVariables.set("linkId", l.id); pm.test("token shown once", () => pm.expect(l.token.length).to.be.above(30));
pm.test("expires in 60 days by default", () => pm.expect(new Date(l.expiresAt) - Date.now()).to.be.within(59.9 * 864e5, 60.1 * 864e5));

item.name: The decisions through the link, in its language

exec: pm.test("shape", () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.language).to.eql("uk"); pm.expect(r.items).to.be.an("array"); });

item.name: An unknown decision cannot be answered through the link
A revoked link stops working at once
Restoring a field that is not archived is 404
Save my name and interface language on the server

exec: pm.test("saved", () => { const m = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(m.name).to.eql("Olena K."); pm.expect(m.uiLanguage).to.eql("uk"); });

item.name: An empty profile change is invalid
Password change with a wrong current password is 401
A too short new password is invalid
After signing out everywhere the session is gone
Sign up a user who will forget the password
Forgot password for an unknown address answers the same
Forgot password for a known address answers the same
A short new password is invalid
The old password no longer works
